description: Social inbox comments and replies for Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads, and LinkedIn Pages (Pro plan or higher plus posts:read). Without comment_id: list comments filtered by account, platform, unread/flagged, search, or since/until dates, with limit/offset paging. With comment_id: one comment and its replies; only workspace_id may be added. YouTube and TikTok are refused rather than returned as an empty list. They stay off until each platform is reviewed and an inbox provider exists.

search.description: Search comment content or author username.

workspace_id.description: Omit to search all your workspaces, or pass an ID from whoami.

name: list_comments
